title: Plot Twist: Spot the Drama
one_line: Spot the differences in soap-opera scenes: weddings, first dates, office meltdowns and more.
how_to_play: Two pictures, one scene. Tap anything that changed in either picture. Wrong taps cost a heart; pinch or scroll to zoom, and use a hint if you're stuck.
description: Every episode is a new drama: a wedding objection, a disastrous first date, a reply-all office scandal. Compare the two pictures and tap every difference: a missing cushion, a new pair of glasses, a shocked face, a flipped cat. Find them fast to chain combos, finish with no mistakes for three stars, and beat your best time. Endless episodes that get trickier as you go, hints that refill over time, and a new Daily Drama every day to keep your streak alive.
